name: The Heart, Fickle and Impermanent
description:
If you wish to prove yourself before a legend, you must first approach perfection. Only the commoners shall bleed. Only the noble shall face slander. 
<Static Roadblock> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<Talulah, the Fighter> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.
